name: Farm
description: Starting/home location used throughout Chapter 1: Home. Farming tutorial objectives and the player's plot are located here.

name: Dewdrop Village
description: Village hub described by Theron as the safest corner of a wide world. Current verified service NPCs include Breda, Eren, Neria, Rendall, Theron, Arlette, Hogan, and Leaf.
source: User-supplied in-game NPC and Theron dialogue screenshots

name: Goblin Junkyard
description: Region referenced by Chapter 1: Home. The Scrap Fields are located within the Goblin Junkyard.

name: Scrap Fields
description: Chapter 1 sends the player here to defeat Cog Crabs and collect Scrap Metal.
